_comment: Toolchain pin for the `layout/erc/` flow (`klt erc`) -- the ERC analogue
of layout/toolchain.json's DRC/LVS pin and signoff/toolchain.json's
grader pin. Checked, not merely recorded: `layout/erc/run_erc.py`
refuses to run under a `klt` whose `klt version --format json` identity
does not match the two pinned fields below.
WHY THIS FLOW HAS ITS OWN PIN INSTEAD OF SHARING layout/toolchain.json.
That file pins `85b8125` (2026-08-16) and is asserted by
layout/drc/run_drc.py and layout/lvs/run_lvs.py. Every committed DRC
and LVS report in this repo was minted under it, and re-pinning it is a
re-baselining of that whole evidence trail -- a change worth making
deliberately, on its own, not as a side effect of standing up ERC.
`klt erc` at `85b8125` is also simply not usable for item-11 evidence:
it predates klayout-tools#1968 (the `status` + `provenance` block
without which `klt signoff` cannot grade the envelope at all), #1979
(`stackup[0].active_layer`, the `poly n diff` gate area), #2036
(`provenance.spec.content_hash`, without which a committed report
cannot be re-verified against the declarations it was run with), #2169
(`ties[]` isolation and `tap_requires`), #2183 (`devices[]`), #2199
(the degenerate-tie skip) and #2179 (`erc_status`). The supply spec
beside this file uses five of those seven.
WHY THIS COMMIT SPECIFICALLY. It is the build signoff/toolchain.json
already pins, so the T1 grader and the artifact it grades come from one
`klt`. Picking a different commit here would mean this repo's item-11
evidence was produced by a build its own grader is not allowed to run
under -- reproducible, but pointlessly harder to reason about.
Bumping this pin is a reviewed change, like every other pin in this
repo: re-run `python3 layout/erc/run_erc.py`, read the diff of the
committed reports case by case, and write what moved into the new
record under layout/erc/records/. The controls under layout/erc/
controls/ exist precisely so a bump that changes a known-gap outcome
(an upstream fix for the implant-free tie declaration, say) fails the
run instead of being inherited silently.
klt_install         `pip install` VCS URL with an exact `@<sha>`, not a
floating branch.
klt_git_commit      the commit `klt_install` resolves to, restated so
it is readable without parsing the URL, and
asserted against `klt version`'s own `git_commit`.
klt_version         `klt version`'s `version` string for that commit.
klayout_package     the pip `klayout` version every committed report
here was produced under, echoed in each report's
own `provenance.klayout_version`. `klt erc`'s
connectivity model IS klayout's LayoutToNetlist,
so this is part of what produced the numbers, not
an incidental detail. Recorded and reported by
run_erc.py; not asserted, because the pinned `klt`
carries its own expectation of it
(`klayout_version_expected`) and a mismatch there
is upstream's signal to give, not this repo's.
minimum_upstream_issue  the upstream change below which this flow's
spec would not even parse, recorded so a future
bump can tell `newer` from `new enough`.
minimum_upstream_issue: klayout-tools#2183 (`devices[]`); #2199 for the degenerate-tie skip the controls/ cases assert
